items.heading: Ropa Vieja
details: Key ingredients: flank steak, bell peppers, onion, tomato, garlic
Simmer flank steak until very tender, then shred it into strands.
Saute peppers, onion and garlic until soft.
Add tomato sauce and the shredded beef, simmering to combine.
Cook until the sauce thickens and serve with rice and beans.

items.heading: Moros y Cristianos
details: Key ingredients: black beans, rice, onion, garlic, cumin
Cook black beans with onion, garlic and cumin until tender.
Saute rice briefly in the seasoned bean liquid.
Combine the rice and beans in one pot with more liquid.
Simmer covered until the rice is fully cooked and infused with flavor.
